additional_reviewer: assembly_fit: independent mechanical scope, dimensions, deliverables and acceptance boundaries
scope: Independent review of the R2b plan, service pin table and new overriding precision in compact/PLANUNG.md. Planning suitability only; no schematic/layout, firmware, eFuse, procurement, manufacturing or operating release. Existing R2a review order remains unchanged.
confirmed_requirements: 25x20mm is a size objective; provisional25x35mm assembled XY is explicitly an unproven planning assumption. Final PCB/part/connector/mating-cable envelopes and height remain to be measured.
Direct USB-C plus an additional physical GPIO-JTAG connector are both required. A separate connector is not falsely claimed to create a second simultaneous JTAG master.
Externally power through J1 with battery removed; USB VBUS supplies neither BAT nor3V3 and does not charge the battery. A single USB cable does not power this initial variant.

All necessary printable fixture parts are mandatory deliverables. Section11 requires editable parametric CAD/STEP, individually named millimetre STL/quantities, genuine P1S3MF settings, instructions and revision manifest. Optional pogo and R2a compatibility only expand the deliverables if selected/needed.
R2a order is neither cancelled nor replaced, paid or resubmitted by this plan. December fallback and four-hour physical acceptance goal remain.

pin_review.recovery: TX43/U1.39;RX44/U1.40;BOOT0/U1.4;CHIP_EN/U1.45 preserved. R2a R10 provides GPIO46 pull-down for joint-download boot.
pin_review.connector: Planned SEGGER9-pin layout matches VTref1,TMS2,GND3,TCK4,GND5,TDO6,key7,TDI8,NC9,nRESET10. This does not establish compatibility with any arbitrary ARM/SWD probe.

efuse_review.result: Correct conditional plan: after separately authorized STRAP_JTAG_SEL programming, GPIO3 low at hardware reset selects pad JTAG and high selects USB JTAG. GPIO3 needs its explicit external pull;10k is a candidate, not a measured design. Fuse programming itself is irreversible and is not performed or authorized by this review. USB CDC operation is distinct from JTAG source selection.
efuse_review.required_future_checks: Read chip identity and relevant actual eFuses first, including DIS_PAD_JTAG,DIS_USB_JTAG and security/debug/download restrictions. Confirm the source-control truth table for that state; do not assume STRAP_JTAG_SEL alone can undo already disabled paths. Freeze tested ESP-IDF/OpenOCD/probe versions.

reset_and_supply_review.result: Open-drain/reset-to-ground requirement is compatible with existing U3-PG on CHIP_EN; no active-high probe drive may fight PG. The plan correctly leaves USB VBUS detection, valid-target-power logic and powered-off data protection as a concrete open design package.
implementation_checks: Preserve GPIO46 low and GPIO0 boot pull. Demonstrate hardware-reset low and supply-stable intervals of at least50us, and strap hold for at least3ms after EN release, with selected adapter, RC network and startup/brownout cases. Do not silently replace the existing qualified topology with generic reset RC values.
Treat valid3V3 as a measured/computed condition over tolerances. Existing regulator PG is not automatically an independent3.0V supervisor. Include power-off, slow rise/fall and UVLO cycling.

Choose real data switch/ESD/VBUS detector parts and check all powered/unpowered pin limits and clamp paths. USB attach must depend on host VBUS and valid target supply in hardware, including ROM boot/recovery. Define USB GND, CC1/CC2, shield and no-power-backfeed connections in the complete schematic.

Choose the actual probe/cable: VTref is reference only, target-off signal behavior and open-drain nRESET must be proven. Set the permitted J1 bench-voltage/current-limit range and verify polarity before powered fixture tests.

mechanical_review.result: No false finished-geometry or printability claim found. Actual connectors/mates/cable bends, underside heights, supports, strain relief and antenna separation are explicitly deferred to final CAD and real samples. R2a/R2b inserts are not assumed interchangeable.
implementation_checks: Missing contact7 is not by itself proof of reverse-insertion protection; qualify the chosen keyed housing AND mating connector in the assembly model and physical sample.
Before mechanical freeze, set measurable cable/connector pull loads, permissible movement/clamp deflection and repeat-cycle count. Current plan names these tests without numerical pass limits.

Bind all actually necessary printed parts, fasteners and purchased contacts to a frozen piece list. Verify every STL/3MF in the selected P1S slicer and then actual fit, support, accessibility and contact working stroke.
Antenna keepout/RF and service-hardware placement require final-model and product testing. A plastic holder or a15mm planning allowance is not proof of RF performance or ESD safety.

digital_vs_physical: No new R2b ERC/DRC, routing, CAM, printed sample, connector fit, ROM recovery, JTAG operation, backfeed/ESD, power/thermal/RF or four-hour test exists from this planning review. Section11 explicitly leaves digital, printed-sample and electrical acceptance separate and incomplete.
